apps.versionDescription: v1.5.12 — LoopLab parity: the A–B steppers go flat in the web's design (40 pt step squares, centred value, ghost Set); ＋ New group follows the web — instant create with auto-name and palette colour, then a checklist of the items visible at that level; and tapping a loop or group zooms the waveform to fit it, centred. Also carries v1.5.11 (single-playback funnel) and v1.5.10 (editor Cancel).
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
